mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a single month is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financing conditions for corporate investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during such spikes (p > 0.05), or the S&P 500 closes higher than the 20-day moving average during the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower expected labor cost growth supports corporate pricing power.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during UNRATE > 4% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of YoY growth in GDPC1 (real private demand) exceeding 2% is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as strong consumer demand anticipates equity market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive or statistically significant (p > 0.05) during such months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO above 2% signals supply-side weakness, which is expected to produce negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate slower economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during INDPRO declines > -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both show a double-dip in inflation-adjusted rates (peak then trough within a month), a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return is expected as a sign of policy normalization.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL form a double-dip pattern in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during such double-dip episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS by at least 10,000 jobs over three months predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly increases for 3 consecutive months each ≥ 10,000
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or not significant (p > 0.05) during such labor gains.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 5% in the same month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as dual demand signals boost market optimism.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by ≥ 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during such joint increases.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for two consecutive months in a low-inflation regime, a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return is expected as weaker labor constraints support lower equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the specified UNRATE regime.
